scientific_integrity: The phase-stiffness coefficient is derived analytically from the published factorized exponential-map Jacobian; no numerical fitting or finite-experiment inference is used.
scientific_limitations: Local phase expansion near the exceptional phases in the source canonical parameters, for each fixed positive pitch. No global monotonicity of the full conjugate-time function, higher-order phase term, or transfer to other Carnot groups is claimed. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact phase stiffness of the cut–conjugate gap across pitch in path groups
